name: omnisense/omnistate
description: Omnistate: one contract for what states and registries know - companies, VAT numbers, domains and networks, professionals, civil records, public statistics (the Omnipay of public registers), each register's usage policy enforced.

suggest.ext-simplexml: Omnistate\Sdmx\Structures: the SDMX-ML messages of the statistics sources (omnistate/insee, omnistate/ecb)
suggest.phpunit/phpunit: In a register's tests: Omnistate\Testing\RegistryContractTests, the family's conformance suite (with symfony/http-client's MockHttpClient)
suggest.symfony/cache-contracts: Answers kept a while: registries change slowly, and some count their calls
suggest.symfony/config: In a Symfony application: the configuration of Omnistate\Bridge\Symfony\OmnistateBundle
suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: In a Symfony application: the services of Omnistate\Bridge\Symfony\OmnistateBundle
suggest.symfony/form: In a Symfony application: the company search field (CompanySearchType)
suggest.symfony/http-foundation: In a Symfony application: the company search endpoint's request and response
suggest.symfony/http-kernel: In a Symfony application: Omnistate\Bridge\Symfony\OmnistateBundle itself
suggest.symfony/routing: In a Symfony application: the company search endpoint (CompanySearchController)
suggest.symfony/validator: In a Symfony application: the #[Siren], #[Siret] and #[VatNumber] constraints
suggest.omnistate/vies: EU VAT numbers, checked with the European Commission's VIES
suggest.omnistate/annuaire-entreprises: French companies, from the State's Recherche d'entreprises API
suggest.omnistate/iana: Domains, IP addresses and AS numbers, through IANA's RDAP bootstrap
suggest.omnistate/annuaire-sante: French health professionals (RPPS) and facilities (FINESS), through the ANS's FHIR API
suggest.omnistate/matchid: French deaths since 1970 (INSEE's file), through matchID
suggest.omnistate/openarchieven: Births, marriages, deaths and more from the archives of the Netherlands and Belgium, with scans, through Open Archives
suggest.omnistate/national-archives-uk: The UK National Archives' Discovery catalogue: documents about a person, not civil registration
suggest.omnistate/nara: The US National Archives Catalog: federal files about a person, with links to their scans, not civil registration (an API key)
suggest.omnistate/insee: French statistics from INSEE's BDM: the rent and lease indices (IRL, ICC, ILC, ILAT), consumer prices, every series by its idBank
suggest.omnistate/eurostat: European statistics from Eurostat's dissemination API (JSON-stat), no key
suggest.omnistate/ecb: The European Central Bank's statistics (SDMX): euro reference exchange rates, key interest rates, no key
